verdicts.evidence: P1 security/configuration: src/auth.ts:6-13 falls back to a repository-visible fixed AUTH_SECRET placeholder; .github/workflows/deploy-vps.yml:189-217 warns instead of failing closed.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Inspect the cited lines, unset AUTH_SECRET, start the production build, and exercise the Auth.js route; verify that startup continues with the fixed secret.

verdicts.evidence: P1 security/navigation: app/login/page.tsx:9-13 redirects directly to params.callbackUrl without same-origin validation.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Open /login?callbackUrl=https://evil.example (also test //evil.example and encoded variants) and observe the redirect target.

verdicts.evidence: P1 functional/auth: src/server/auth-session.ts:21-25,33-39 redirects to /login without a return path; app/login/page.tsx:18-23 signs in with redirectTo '/'.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Request an unauthenticated detail URL, complete the login action, and verify that navigation ends at / instead of the original pathname and query.

verdicts.evidence: P1 functional/enrollment: app/_components/enroll-flow-card.tsx:74-110 treats any device outside the initial set as this enrollment; app/api/devices/route.ts:6-10 uses the 30-second cached getDeviceSummary at src/server/summaries.ts:1121-1128.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Create an enrollment, add a different device concurrently, and poll the UI; then add the intended device and inspect whether the endpoint can remain stale for up to 30 seconds.

verdicts.evidence: P1 security/xss: app/devices/daily-device-cost-chart.tsx:64-80 and app/daily-source-chart.tsx:79-95 interpolate item.name into custom tooltip HTML; ApexCharts writes the tooltip through innerHTML at node_modules/apexcharts/src/modules/tooltip/Tooltip.js:526.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Register or ingest a name such as and hover the device/source chart; confirm the rendered tooltip treats the value as markup.

verdicts.evidence: P1 performance/architecture: app/layout.tsx:21-27, app/session-provider.tsx:5-10, src/server/auth-session.ts:21-27, and app/devices/page.tsx:75-81,128-132,145-149 independently resolve the same session; the client provider does not receive an initial session.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Load /devices with an authenticated browser, capture server/database traces and browser requests, and count repeated auth() calls plus /api/auth/session.

verdicts.evidence: P1 performance/refresh: app/_components/auto-refresh.tsx:19-56 calls router.refresh() every 30 seconds while layout and dashboard sections re-run auth, agent-version, and multiple aggregate queries.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Keep dashboard, devices, and harness tabs visible for 90 seconds, record RSC/network requests, and compare query/chart work at each refresh tick.

verdicts.evidence: P1 performance/scalability: app/harness/page.tsx:44-64 and app/devices/page.tsx:145-149 use unbounded findMany and render all rows; prisma/schema.prisma:456-459 lacks the userId+consumedAt/order composite gate index.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Seed a tenant with thousands of projects, gates, and devices, request /harness and /devices, and measure query time, response size, DOM node count, and scroll responsiveness.

verdicts.evidence: P1 functional/data-correctness: rangeWhere('all') in src/server/summaries.ts:21-32 is unbounded, while daysForRange and daily queries at :878-882 and :914-1025 cap the chart at 180 days; UI still labels it All time.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Seed events older than 180 days, select All, and compare KPI totals with the daily chart sum and subtitle.

verdicts.evidence: P1 functional/onboarding: app/page.tsx:77-99 returns OnboardingCard whenever the selected range summary has eventCount zero; RangeSelector is only rendered in the normal branch at :104-122.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Use an account with only old events, open /?range=7d (or 30d), and verify that onboarding replaces the dashboard and removes the control needed to return to All.

verdicts.evidence: P1 functional/timezone: timezone-reporter PATCHes the browser zone only after mount (app/_components/timezone-reporter.tsx:9-19), while server pages read the default Asia/Shanghai before render (src/server/timezone.ts:4,17-31); no refresh follows success.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: For a new user in a non-Asia/Shanghai zone, open dashboard/events/model detail, compare first-render buckets with the browser zone, then navigate again and observe the correction.

verdicts.evidence: P2 functional/data-correctness: rolling SQL bounds use Date.now()-N*day in src/server/summaries.ts:631-645,680-695,914-1025, but output buckets start at local midnight in :887-905.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Set a timezone with a non-midnight current time, select a rolling range, and compare the first displayed local day with raw events around the lower bound; repeat across DST.

verdicts.evidence: P2 functional/date-picker: app/models/[model]/model-range-picker.tsx:41-63 leaves localFrom/localTo stale after preset navigation; server queries use [from,to) while src/server/time-buckets.ts:112-125 includes <= to.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Click a model range preset, inspect the datetime inputs, click Apply, and test a to value on a bucket boundary for an extra empty endpoint bucket.

verdicts.evidence: P2 performance/frontend: dashboard chart components use ssr:false but have no viewport lazy loading; the production ApexCharts shared chunk is about 535KB raw (about 139KB gzip).
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Run npm run build, inspect the emitted ApexCharts chunk, then load the dashboard with a cold cache and observe that below-fold chart scripts and instances initialize before scrolling.

verdicts.evidence: P2 performance/data-access: app/devices/page.tsx:75-94 calls the all-time getDeviceSummary only to derive initial device IDs, then runs range and table queries at :128-149; the summary performs full event groupBys.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Clear server cache, open /devices?range=7d with a large event history, and trace the first all-time aggregate before the actual daily/table queries.

verdicts.evidence: P2 performance/background-work: pending-gates-badge polls without visibility or in-flight guards, Navbar mounts it globally, Harness refreshes its own data, and timezone updates are unconditional (app/_components/pending-gates-badge.tsx:17-35; src/server/timezone.ts:38-43).
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Open multiple tabs, background one tab, visit /harness, and monitor requests and User UPDATE statements for several polling intervals.

verdicts.evidence: P2 functional/error-handling: app/admin/pricing/pricing-actions.tsx:134-165 starts an async scan callback without catch/finally around fetch.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Block the pricing endpoint or disconnect the network, click Scan now, and observe the unhandled rejection and missing user-facing error state.

verdicts.evidence: P2 functional/auth-config: src/auth.ts:38-49 creates no provider without AUTH_RESEND_KEY, while app/login/page.tsx:15-23 does not catch signIn and therefore cannot render the documented Configuration state.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Unset AUTH_RESEND_KEY, submit the login form, and verify that the action throws into a generic error path instead of the translated configuration message.

verdicts.evidence: P2 functional/UX: app/ has no route loading.tsx, error.tsx, or global-error.tsx beyond a nested not-found; Suspense boundaries in app/page.tsx only cover pending rendering.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Force a server aggregate or external pricing query to fail during a route request/RSC refresh and observe the lack of a localized retry boundary.

verdicts.evidence: P2 functional/UX: events and detail pages render empty tbody values without EmptyState, while src/server/summaries.ts:255,413,800 cap detail events at take:100 with no continuation UI.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Open an empty tenant/filter and a detail record with more than 100 events; verify the blank table and inability to request records after the first 100.

verdicts.evidence: P2 accessibility/responsive: the mobile sidebar uses a clickable span, lacks inert/focus management and does not close on route changes; form semantics are incomplete, while approve and reject badges share the same green styling (app/admin-shell.tsx:19-35; src/components/sidebar/index.tsx:16-21; app/harness/page.tsx:136-149).
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: At mobile width open the sidebar, activate a route, then tab through the new page; verify the drawer remains open and hidden links remain focusable. Inspect approved and rejected gate badges for indistinguishable green semantics.

verdicts.evidence: P2 i18n/data-labeling: onboarding/enrollment/admin/navbar contain hard-coded Chinese and English strings, number/date formatting is fixed, and messages/en.json plus zh-CN.json hard-code Asia/Shanghai in chart subtitles even though data is bucketed in each user's timezone.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Switch locale and use a non-Asia/Shanghai timezone; compare visible/aria strings and number/date formatting, then compare the chart subtitle's claimed timezone with the actual bucket boundaries.

verdicts.evidence: P2 performance/architecture: global CSS repeats remote Google Font imports and legacy styles; app/layout.tsx sends the complete messages payload and has no server-rendered theme class, while Navbar applies dark mode only after hydration.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Run a cold production load with stored/system dark mode and inspect the light-to-dark flash, CSS/font requests, and serialized message payload on a route needing one small namespace.

verdicts.evidence: P2 functional/performance: app/models/[model]/model-range-picker.tsx:73-94 has no max span; page parsing accepts arbitrary finite from/to and time-buckets.ts only caps generated buckets at 10,000.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Request /models/<model>?from=1900-01-01T00:00&to=2100-01-01T00:00 and inspect aggregate latency, bucket count, and response size.

verdicts.evidence: P2 responsive UX: breakdown tables in app/projects/[id]/page.tsx:83-143, app/models/[model]/page.tsx:199-337, and app/devices/[id]/page.tsx:272-354 are not inside horizontal overflow containers.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Render each detail route at 320px and 390px widths with long entity names and inspect document scroll width, clipped columns, and card overflow.

verdicts.evidence: P2 accessibility: daily usage/cost/source/device chart wrappers render ApexCharts without aria-label, textual summary, or hidden data table (app/daily-*-chart.tsx and app/devices/daily-device-cost-chart.tsx).
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Run an axe/screen-reader pass on dashboard and device detail charts, move focus through the page, and verify that trend and data values have a non-visual alternative.

verdicts.evidence: P2 performance/data-access: uncached getDeviceDetail and getProjectDetail in src/server/summaries.ts:245-293,792-824 perform modelCostRows and a second costForWhere groupBy plus events/breakdowns; device detail also auto-refreshes.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Open a detail route with a large event set, capture Prisma query traces across one request and one 30-second refresh, and count repeated groupBy scans over the same range.

verdicts.evidence: P2 functional/UX: app/events/page.tsx:56-59 always passes events.length to the subtitle, while messages/en.json:131 labels the result Latest even after an Older cursor.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Open /events, click Older, and verify that the subtitle remains Latest N instead of identifying the historical page or its time range.

verdicts.evidence: P3 architecture/type-safety: tsconfig.json:5-9 disables strict/null/implicit-any checks; shared chart/card components use any and package.json retains legacy template dependencies.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Inspect tsconfig and shared component props, run npm ls/bundle analysis, and trace whether the legacy packages are reachable from current app routes.

verdicts.evidence: P3 testing: tests/ contains server/shared/CLI coverage but no Playwright, React Testing Library, or axe suite for the listed browser flows.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Run npm test and inventory test dependencies/files; attempt to exercise login deep links, enrollment polling, range picker, locale, keyboard, and tooltip flows and observe no automated browser gate.

verdicts.evidence: P1 financial correctness: src/server/harness-cost.ts:74-106 leaves terminal statuses open until now, silently skips unpriced costs, and merges capped intervals under the successor phase; detail inputs are also capped at 100 transitions and omit observedAfter uncertainty.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Build intervals ending in done and advance now, then add post-completion usage and observe the completed batch total continue growing. Repeat with an unpriced model and more than 100/60 transitions to observe silent under-counting or corrupted phase/rework attribution.

verdicts.evidence: P1 performance/scalability: src/server/harness-cost.ts:110-171 issues one concurrent UsageEvent groupBy per interval (up to 60), while app/projects/[id]/page.tsx:31-84 repeats it for every unbounded HarnessProject and the 30-second now key rotates continuously.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Associate N harness projects with a usage project, seed 60 phase intervals each, open the project page on a cold cache, and count up to N*60 concurrent groupBy calls; keep detail open across 30-second refresh ticks.

verdicts.evidence: P1 authorization race: app/api/harness/gates/route.ts:73-84 reads an undecided gate, then :112-121 performs an unconditional update by id after signing, without a transaction or compare-and-swap predicate.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Send concurrent approve and reject POSTs for the same undecided gate from separate sessions/tabs; both can pass the null check and return success, with the later signed decision overwriting the first.

verdicts.evidence: P2 functional/performance: src/server/summaries.ts:728-787 takes the global top 40 projects before applying gitOnly, then scans all project-model cost groups even though only 20 rows are returned.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Seed more than 40 higher-token non-git projects and lower-ranked git projects, select Git only, and observe valid git projects disappear from the result.

verdicts.evidence: P1 quota correctness: src/server/quota.ts:43-77 selects latest rows by provider+windowKey but omits accountKey, then combines the selected windows under one provider card/account identity.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Upload primary, weekly, plan, and credit snapshots from two accounts at staggered times; observe one dashboard card combine windows that do not belong to the same account.

verdicts.evidence: P2 quota reliability: src/quota/run.ts:29-59 stores provider errors only in local agent state, server/UI expose snapshots only, and codex-chatgpt.ts:58-61 uses bare fetch instead of the proxy-aware agent fetch path.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Expire the provider token or run behind a required proxy while retaining an old snapshot; verify local state records failure but the dashboard continues showing stale quota without an error/reconnect state.

verdicts.evidence: P2 database scalability: active agents append multiple QuotaSnapshot rows every 60 seconds, while src/server/quota.ts:43-53 repeatedly computes latest windows over all user history with no retention, rollup, or current-state table.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Generate months of per-minute snapshots, expire the 30-second cache, and compare EXPLAIN/latency/index reads for getQuotaLatest as history grows.

verdicts.evidence: P2 validation/security boundary: app/api/quota/snapshots/batch/route.ts:27-55 only checks that snapshots is an array before constructing Decimal, BigInt, Date, and createMany values; no body, batch, range, length, or JSON-size limits exist.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: POST a valid device token with invalid dates, non-finite/unsafe numbers, negative utilization, oversized strings/raw JSON, or a huge array; inspect whole-batch 500s/resource use and a progress bar wider than 100%.

verdicts.evidence: P2 functional/i18n: SubscriptionCard wraps an already complete relative-time phrase in messages that append ago/before, uses the past-time formatter for future resets, and hard-codes a 5h code-review label although fixture window_minutes is 60.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Render quota data in en and zh-CN with a recent capture and future reset; observe duplicated ago/before suffixes, an absolute reset date instead of a countdown, and a 1h window labeled 5h.

verdicts.evidence: P3 missing functionality/architecture: src/quota/registry.ts:4-6 and SubscriptionCard implement only codex-chatgpt; the repository roadmap explicitly records missing Claude/Kimi subscription windows and no generic provider/account UI exists.
verdicts.steps_to_reproduce: Use a tenant with Claude Code or Kimi usage but no Codex snapshot and open the dashboard; verify there is no corresponding subscription quota card, provider selector, or provider health state.
